dict.string: Record voice messages or your doctor visits on this device. You choose when recording starts and stops.
Transcribe voice messages and doctor visits on this device into editable text.
Import heart rate, blood pressure, and temperature readings that you choose to share.
Harbour uses Apple Health to import readings. It does not add or change Apple Health records.
Use Face ID to unlock your Harbour health records.
Read the medicine label you choose to photograph. You review the details before saving.
